name: software-factory
description: The control room for the label-driven delivery pipeline. Watches a GitHub repository's kiro-* issues and pull requests as a stage board, joins every hop to the Kiro Crew agent run that performed it (template, model, duration, credits, tool calls), lets you open a run's transcript while it is still executing, and shows the health of the runner, webhook sources and installed templates. Observes only; it never labels, dispatches or merges.
author: aidin-repo
highlights: Stage board: planning, implementing, review, gate, ready, parked, shipped, with time in stage and review rounds
Every hop linked to its agent run: template, model, duration, credits and tool-call count
Watch a running agent's transcript step by step, or read a finished one
Trace view: every hop as a span tree on one time axis (turns, model time, tool calls) with durations, approval waits, input and output
Per-agent statistics: runs, failures, average and p90 duration, average credits, model
Infrastructure health: Actions runner, inbound-webhook switch, sources, installed templates, recent workflow runs
Keeps its own run ledger so history outlives the gateway's 50-run ring
configuration: Log in gh on the gateway host with read access to the watched repository (the default is aidin-repo/task-chatbot; change it with POST /apps/software-factory/api/config {"repo": "owner/name"}).
Run the app on the same gateway that executes the webhook hops, otherwise agent runs and transcripts are not visible.
